method: A disposable player instance per clip. All MonoBehaviours disabled, physics and colliders disabled, nested Animators removed. The valid root Humanoid Animator is evaluated by a manual AnimationClipPlayable, no controller, root motion, foot IK or playable IK. 120 inclusive samples cover the imported clip's own duration, independently of controller state speed. Actor origin and Y=90 facing +X are reset before/after each evaluation. Coordinates and body direction are recorded after evaluation; mesh world bounds are baked every fourth sample and the last sample.
strideMethod: For each foot, low stance is minY + 0.25*(maxY-minY). Central finite differences of world +X foot position give forward velocity. Samples with foot at/below that threshold and velocity < -0.01 m/s are collected across both feet. The median of their negated velocities estimates naturalStrideSpeed. Walk/Run only; it is an in-place visual stride estimate, not measured game movement speed or an automatic playback recommendation.
sourceNotes: Walk and Run: Protagonist01_Walk.fbx / Protagonist01_Run.fbx. Punch and JumpFull: Protagonist01_Actions.fbx. Six extra actions: Protagonist01_ExtendedActions.fbx (Stand_and_Drink, Over_Shoulder_Throw, Left_Slash, mage_soell_cast, open_door, Male_Bend_Over_Pick_Up). Dash, Hit and Dead: Assets/Anim/Clips/*.anim. Source-take/import frame intervals are included when a ModelImporter exists.
limitations: Source-take duration assumes the imported clip frame rate. If an FBX import interval was trimmed before this analysis, only that imported interval can be sampled without reimporting; sourceNormalizedTime/sourceSeconds map poses back to the original default take and importRangeMatchesFullSource explicitly reports this. No collision, foot planting IK, physics trajectory, equipped props or controller transitions are applied. Mesh minY includes the full character silhouette and is not solely a foot sole. Resetting the actor root intentionally exposes pose height and side-to-side/depth motion retained in the imported pose.
